entries.2761880dcac97c6f: Since its founding, the company has continued to make products related to electricity, and through electricity meters it has supported the stable supply and efficient use of electric power, a social infrastructure. Even as mechanical electricity meters have evolved into smart meters, products and services that make electricity visible remain its core products. In Japan, it has a track record of supplying smart meters to electric power companies nationwide; overseas, the EDMI Group has built a structure to manufacture and sell smart meters and related systems in Singapore, Australia, the United Kingdom, China, Malaysia and others.
entries.3e654b9ae2534485: Customers are electric power companies in Japan and overseas, among others.
entries.45c99ad3fc039467: Osaki Electric Co., Ltd. is a measurement and control equipment manufacturer headquartered in Higashi-Gotanda, Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo, and listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. It operates together with 25 consolidated subsidiaries, and its consolidated number of employees is 2,504 (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.5d791e54ce818098: Consolidated revenue of ¥100,900 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 consists of revenue from external customers by segment: ¥59,707 million for the Domestic Measurement and Control Business, ¥40,862 million for the Overseas Measurement and Control Business, and ¥330 million for the Real Estate Business. By region, revenue from contracts with customers was ¥59,707 million in Japan, ¥15,880 million in Oceania, ¥15,342 million in Europe, ¥4,846 million in Asia and ¥4,793 million in other regions. Sales to its major customer, Kansai Transmission and Distribution, Inc., were ¥19,657 million, accounting for 19.5% of total sales. Kyushu Electric Power Co., Inc. is also a major business partner in the smart meter business, but it is not linked as a related company because it has no entry in this encyclopedia.
entries.5f74bcb3d065e142: The basic policy of the medium-term management plan for fiscal 2024 through fiscal 2026 is “Maximize group synergies, and aim for sustainable growth of the entire group through providing new solutions to social issues such as realizing a decarbonized society, with smart meters at the core.” In Japan, it will work on stable and reliable shipments of second-generation smart meters, which have begun to be delivered to all electric power companies nationwide, and on cost reduction through automation of production processes and labor savings using AI and other technologies. Overseas, it will work on launching the next-generation smart meter “NEOS” in the market and on expanding sales of solutions combined with upper-level systems.
